subject.title: Add LLMTR provider (Turkey-hosted OpenAI-compatible AI gateway)

question: Should LLMTR be accepted as a bundled OpenClaw provider, or should the implementation move to an external plugin/ClawHub package using the existing provider seams?
rationale: The request adds an optional provider and credential/configuration surface, and repository policy prefers external ownership unless a maintainer explicitly chooses bundled distribution or identifies a missing extension API.

options.title: Route it to an external plugin
options.body: Ask for an independently packaged LLMTR provider with manifest metadata, credential/setup documentation, model discovery behavior, and live smoke proof.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled provider
options.body: Confirm that LLMTR meets the bar for a maintained bundled provider, then review the linked PR for API, catalog, upgrade, and operational ownership.

recommendation.title: Route it to an external plugin
recommendation.body: Ask for an independently packaged LLMTR provider with manifest metadata, credential/setup documentation, model discovery behavior, and live smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely repository-level owner for the bundled-provider versus external-plugin product boundary, though file-history routing could not be completed here.
